title: Сортировка 4-х Будущих (Сравнение)
description: Распредели предложения по группам будущих времён (Future Simple, Future Continuous, Future Perfect, Present Continuous, Present Simple).

items.verb: I think I will buy this.
At 5 PM I will be flying to Rome.
By 5 PM I will have finished the project.
This time next week I will be lying on the beach.
I will help you with your homework.
By the time you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.
